'''Carner''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Major General]]. He was the father of [[Lej Carner]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], he was stationed on [[Garos IV]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While stationed on Garos IV, Carner was in charge of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities.
